affected_component: product_jobs._wall_clock_date_findings + _assert_reference_reproducible(input_root) in candidate generation; reference-repair prompt clause for WALL_CLOCK_DATE_EMBEDDED
invariant: A reference workspace is not reproducible if any generated UTF-8 text file carries today's date (local or UTC, in the spellings generators stamp) that the input itself does not contain: the probe rejects it as WORKSPACE_REFERENCE_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE / WALL_CLOCK_DATE_EMBEDDED with path=WALL_CLOCK_DATE@line N and an actual-side excerpt, routed to the reference repair whose prompt explains the fix. The two-second rerun remains; this closes its day-resolution blind spot. False-certification exception: a freeze that certifies reproducibility for a golden that only matches on its freeze date issues a certificate that is false the next day, revoking the tool and failing every later run without any change.
